attempts.summary: Gave node1 (SONiC) routed addresses on both its data-plane segments (eth1=172.20.1.1/24 toward node2, eth2=172.20.2.1/24 toward node3), enabled IPv4 forwarding, and added corresponding static routes on node2 and node3 (each pointing to node1 as gateway for the other's subnet). Verified working node2<->node3 path via node1 (ttl=63, one hop). Made the config persist by writing eth1/eth2 static addressing into /etc/network/interfaces.d/datalinks (sourced by SONiC's networking.service, untouched by the interfaces-config.service reconciler that only rewrites the main file for eth0) plus /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf for forwarding, and by creating persistent NetworkManager connection profiles + static routes on node2/node3. Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id + health baseline, issued native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed recovered config/connectivity. All three nodes came back with the config auto-restored and node2<->node3 reachability fully working (0% packet loss) after each restart.
